title: Tone of voice
slide_intent: Introduce voice as a set of writing judgments. Readers need to understand both the purpose of a message and the manner in which it addresses them.
strategic_value: The five named principles can give different writers a shared vocabulary for discussing whether a message sounds like Frontline AIDS.
demonstration: A tight photograph of red lips fills the page. Five colored phrases on black strips cross the image, accompanied by a cyan loop and arrow.
practical_value: Choose the relevant voice principle before drafting. Consult its following page for specific practices and limits.

content_islands.name: Chapter introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the Tone of voice navigation and a brief definition in small type at the upper left over the photograph.

content_islands.name: Five principles
content_islands.spec: Stack straight-talking, confident, urgent, empowering and provocative in offset strips across the lips. Use marker strokes to draw attention to the stack.
